title: Campaigns
subtitle: Your Google Ads campaign plan, worked out from your store's products, margins and sales.
load_error: We could not load the campaign plan.
no_store_title: Connect your store to get a campaign plan
no_store_desc: The plan starts from your store's catalog, margins and sales.
save_error: We could not save. Please try again.
ready_title: The plan is ready to launch
launch_soon: Launching straight from Hontrio is coming soon. Until then, the plan keeps itself up to date from your store data, and the choices you make here are kept.
blocker_ads_account: Choose the Google Ads account to use
blocker_currency: The Google Ads account is in {{account}}, your store in {{store}}: choose an account in {{store}}
blocker_no_offers: No product can enter the campaign right now
existing_ads: Your store already runs Google ads: {{orders}} ({{total}}) in the last 90 days. At launch, Hontrio checks which campaigns run in the account, so the new one does not compete with them for the same products.
goal_hint: Out of the profit on a sale, how much you keep after paying for the ad. With a lower target, Google brings more sales, but each one leaves less profit.
goal_growth_desc: As many sales as possible. You keep ~{{keep}}% of the profit on each.
goal_balanced_desc: Sales and profit in balance. You keep ~{{keep}}% of the profit on each sale.
goal_profit_desc: Fewer sales, but you keep ~{{keep}}% of the profit on each.
goal_roas_unknown: Target ROAS: once you add costs
campaign_hint: What Hontrio will create in your Google Ads account. You pay Google directly for the ads.
type_pmax: Performance Max, from your Merchant Center catalog
type_pmax_hint: One campaign for the whole eligible catalog: Google shows your products in Search, Shopping, YouTube, Gmail and Discover and learns where they sell. With few sales, one campaign learns faster than several small ones.
bidding_target: Maximize conversion value, with a target ROAS of {{roas}}
bidding_no_target: Maximize conversion value (the target ROAS comes from costs)
bidding_hint: Google bids on every impression so that, on average, each unit spent on ads brings that many back in sales.
budget_hint: To learn, the campaign needs ~{{conversions}} sales a month. At an average order value of {{aov}} and ROAS {{roas}}, that is about {{budget}} a day. Leave empty to use the suggested budget.
budget_hint_no_target: Enter how much you want to spend a day. Once you add costs, Hontrio suggests the right budget.
econ_need_costs: To work out the profit threshold and the target ROAS, add the cost price to the products that sell. Right now {{pct}}% of sales have a cost; at least half is needed.
econ_margin_sales: of the campaign products, from 90 days of sales
econ_margin_catalog: of the campaign products, from cost prices
econ_break_even_sub: below it, the campaign loses money
econ_aov_sub: what Google Ads reports for a sale
adjust_intro: The threshold accounts for what Google Ads receives: the order total.
adjust_vat: Of that, the {{vat}}% VAT does not stay with you.
forecast_title: Per month, if the campaign hits the target
forecast_note: Estimate. Sales include VAT, as Google reports them; profit is without VAT and before fixed costs. The first weeks are for learning, and after launch the real figures appear in Reports.
empty_included: No product enters the campaign right now.
col_break_even_hint: The ROAS from which a sale of the product pays for its ad
no_cost_hint: Add the cost price in Products to see the margin
over_target_hint: Above the {{roas}} target ROAS: at the campaign target, its sales can lose money
footer: The plan is worked out from your synced catalog, website orders from the last 90 days and your cost prices. Removed products stay untouched in Merchant Center: Hontrio only keeps them out of the campaign.
blocker_merchant_woocommerce: Send your products to Merchant Center (Google for WooCommerce)
blocker_conversion_edinio: Set up the purchase conversion in Edinio
blocker_conversion_woocommerce: Measure purchases in Google Ads (Google for WooCommerce)
conversion_ok: Purchase, the one already set up via {{via}} (no new one is created)
conversion_ok_unknown: Purchase, the one already set up (no new one is created)
verified_at_launch: Hontrio cannot ask the plugin from here: we check it at launch, from the Google account.
adjust_vat_assumed: Your store does not calculate VAT, so the math assumes the {{vat}}% standard rate, which you do not keep.
blocker_merchant_shopify: Send your products to Merchant Center (Google & YouTube app)
blocker_conversion_shopify: Measure purchases in Google Ads (Google & YouTube app)
verified_at_launch_shopify: Shopify doesn't tell apps which sales channels a store has (Google & YouTube): we check at launch, from the Google account.
blocker_merchant: Send your products to Merchant Center
